CatalogGuestGroups.NumberOfChildren AS NumberOfChildren, CatalogGuestGroups.NumberOfInfants AS NumberOfInfants, CatalogGuestGroups.ColorHexString AS ColorHexString, CatalogGuestGroups.ContactPerson AS ContactPerson, CatalogGuestGroups.TouristicTaxIsCalculatedForMainGroupDocumentOnly AS TouristicTaxIsCalculatedForMainGroupDocumentOnly, CatalogGuestGroups.LastChangeDate AS LastChangeDate, CatalogGuestGroups.LastChangeAuthor AS LastChangeAuthor, CatalogGuestGroups.Payer AS Payer, CatalogGuestGroups.PlannedPaymentMethod AS PlannedPaymentMethod, CatalogGuestGroups.Predefined AS Predefined, CatalogGuestGroups.PredefinedDataName AS PredefinedDataName, CASE WHEN (ISNULL(CatalogGuestGroups.Status.IsPreliminary, FALSE) OR NOT ISNULL(CatalogGuestGroups.Status.IsGuaranteed, TRUE) AND ISNULL(CatalogGuestGroups.Status.IsActive, TRUE) AND NOT ISNULL(CatalogGuestGroups.Status.ServicesAreDelivered, FALSE)) AND CatalogGuestGroups.DateOfDef <= &qToday AND CatalogGuestGroups.DateOfDef <> &qEmptyDate THEN 32 ELSE 0 END AS IsDue FROM Catalog.GuestGroups AS CatalogGuestGroups WHERE CASE WHEN &qStatus = 0 THEN TRUE WHEN &qStatus = 1 AND (CatalogGuestGroups.Status = CatalogGuestGroups.Owner.NewRoomsGroupStatus OR CatalogGuestGroups.Status = CatalogGuestGroups.Owner.NewResourcesGroupStatus) THEN TRUE WHEN &qStatus = 2 THEN ISNULL(CatalogGuestGroups.Status.IsPreliminary, FALSE) AND CatalogGuestGroups.Status <> CatalogGuestGroups.Owner.NewRoomsGroupStatus AND CatalogGuestGroups.Status <> CatalogGuestGroups.Owner.NewResourcesGroupStatus WHEN &qStatus = 3 THEN NOT ISNULL(CatalogGuestGroups.Status.IsGuaranteed, FALSE) AND ISNULL(CatalogGuestGroups.Status.IsActive, FALSE) AND NOT ISNULL(CatalogGuestGroups.Status.ServicesAreDelivered, FALSE) AND NOT CatalogGuestGroups.Status REFS Catalog.AccommodationStatuses AND CatalogGuestGroups.Status <> CatalogGuestGroups.Owner.NewRoomsGroupStatus AND CatalogGuestGroups.Status <> CatalogGuestGroups.Owner.NewResourcesGroupStatus WHEN &qStatus = 4 THEN ISNULL(CatalogGuestGroups.Status.IsGuaranteed, FALSE) AND ISNULL(CatalogGuestGroups.Status.IsActive, FALSE) AND NOT CatalogGuestGroups.Status REFS Catalog.AccommodationStatuses AND CatalogGuestGroups.Status <> CatalogGuestGroups.Owner.NewRoomsGroupStatus AND CatalogGuestGroups.Status <> CatalogGuestGroups.Owner.NewResourcesGroupStatus WHEN &qStatus = 5 THEN CatalogGuestGroups.Status REFS Catalog.AccommodationStatuses WHEN &qStatus = 6 THEN CASE WHEN CatalogGuestGroups.Status REFS Catalog.AccommodationStatuses THEN TRUE WHEN CatalogGuestGroups.Status REFS Catalog.ReservationStatuses AND CatalogGuestGroups.Status.IsActive THEN TRUE WHEN CatalogGuestGroups.Status REFS Catalog.ResourceReservationStatuses AND CatalogGuestGroups.Status.IsActive THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END ELSE FALSE END AND (NOT &qIsDueOnly OR &qIsDueOnly AND CASE WHEN (ISNULL(CatalogGuestGroups.Status.IsPreliminary, FALSE) OR NOT ISNULL(CatalogGuestGroups.Status.IsGuaranteed, TRUE) AND ISNULL(CatalogGuestGroups.Status.IsActive, TRUE) AND NOT ISNULL(CatalogGuestGroups.Status.ServicesAreDelivered, FALSE)) AND CatalogGuestGroups.DateOfDef <= &qToday AND CatalogGuestGroups.DateOfDef <> &qEmptyDate THEN 32 ELSE 0 END = 32)
